description:
Found by cold design review of the kdt.13 v2 proposal (2026-08-29), measured
on enum_take_drop_split at arc HEAD 631da1a6d from the work_graph.applied
stream:

    Activation:      390 first-appearances / 319 distinct facts, 71 RETRACTIONS
    CallSiteSummary: 597 first / 502 distinct, 95 retractions
    CallSiteTargets: 597 first / 502 distinct, 95 retractions
    shift-wakes: 106 (ALL AnalyzeActivation); rebased completions: 183

A transiently-unanalyzable callsite (deliver_tail_value returns Ok(None) on
missing evidence, semantic.rs:889-893) simply does not emit its claims that
run, and plain output replacement treats the omission as WITHDRAWAL. The
retraction is a ground shift (scheduler.rs:391-393) that rebases every reader
-- a self-inflicted cascade, 166 revisions + 106 shift-wakes of pure churn.

The cure already exists in the tree for ActivationInputs:
conclude_preserving_frontier (world.rs:634-641) treats absence as
bottom-not-retraction, with the reasoning written out at semantic.rs:1024-1031.
FOLD the same rule onto Activation, CallSiteSummary, CallSiteTargets:
withdrawal becomes available ONLY on a rebased conclusion.

Red test first: a rebased conclusion DOES withdraw; a non-rebased conclusion
does not.

## Checks (causal stream, three target fixtures)
- Activation retractions 71 -> 0, first-appearances 390 -> 319;
  CallSiteSummary/Targets retractions 95 -> 0, firsts 597 -> 502.
- Shift-wakes 106 -> genuine rebases only; rebased completions < 183.
- AnalyzeActivation evaluations ratchet below 1,383 (correct denominator: 319
  distinct activations).
- fixture_matrix + fz2_cli byte-correct; kdt.34.6 zero-uncaused unweakened.

Independent of the derivation-identity work in fz-kdt.13; land first.
title: Analysis withdraws claims it should keep: absence is not retraction for Activation/CallSiteSummary/CallSiteTargets
